name: Short Cut Korean BBQ Tempeh & Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli, salt, and pepper, then stir-fry until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
½ (510 g) bag broccoli florets
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place rice pouch in the microwave, seam-side up. Heat on high for 3-4 minutes (until pouch balloons up with steam for 30 seconds). Allow steam to vent before opening pouch. (Alternatively, rice can be heated in a saucepan according to package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (283 g) pouch frozen brown rice, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done, crumble tempeh into the skillet with your fingers. Add stir-fry sauce and water, stir to combine, and continue to cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) pkg tempeh
⅓ cup stir-fry sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, tempeh stir-fry, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
